answer: The guard-stick carver shop smells of lacquer, and the long sticks lie seasoned in a rack. Proof of guard-stick carver via guard stick tally — a guard stick the guard-stick carver shapes only after 39 sticks fit true without one warping, each shaped by the guard-stick carver himself. lagoon shapes the outer stick with the plane and rounds the tip. ocean lacquers the stick twice and lets it cure in the sun. dune inlays the pearl and fits the stick to the fan. Thirty-nine guard sticks must fit true without one warping at the tip, and the next still bows where the cedar ran green.
